scope_limitations: Adjudication is bounded to the frozen evidence substrate at the 2026-08-22 cut-off. No new literature discovery was performed.

unresolved_questions: A venous-disease trial with duplex, anatomical and symptom outcomes has not been performed. The absence is a bounded retrieval finding within the documented routes and terminology, not proof that no relevant study exists.

verdict.verdict_summary: No varicose-vein or venous-insufficiency grounding trial was located. The available perfusion, viscosity and plantar-pump material is indirect and cannot speak to venous valve anatomy, reflux or disease progression.
